notes: Six evaluation cases covering the three Step-0 modes (workspace / agent / workspace-confirm-and-update). Cases 1 and 6 test agent and workspace greenfield modes (baseline coverage that v1.2 must not regress). Cases 2-5 cover the new workspace-confirm-and-update mode's triggering surface and the four key branches: conditional gate (offered vs hidden), matching fixture (silent pass), missing-section (additive merge), and conflict-staged (stop-and-ask). Fixtures reuse the regression fixture under ../tests/fixtures/boilerplate-derived/ where possible to avoid duplication. Each case is a realistic user prompt; assertions are programmatically checkable predicates over the agent's transcript and the filesystem post-state.

evals.name: greenfield-workspace-mode-baseline
evals.prompt: I want to set up workspace memory for this repository — there's nothing here yet.
evals.fixture_notes: Empty workspace root. No MEMORY.md, no memories/ folder, no decisions.config.md. The Step 0a gate must fail for the third mode (both MEMORY.md AND non-empty memories/ are absent).
evals.expected_output: Agent invokes the build-agent-memory skill in workspace mode. Step 0a detects no prior state and hides the third option. Step 0b presents the two-option menu. Agent runs Steps 1-10 in workspace mode and produces MEMORY.md + memories/ tree + connectivity-check entry + setup report.

assertions.text: Agent does NOT offer the workspace-confirm-and-update option at Step 0.
assertions.check: transcript: AskUserQuestion (or equivalent) presents only two options at the mode-selection step; the words 'confirm-and-update' or 'already present' do not appear in the offered choices

assertions.text: MEMORY.md is created at the workspace root with MAGI frontmatter and the 9 canonical H2 sections.
assertions.check: filesystem: workspace-root/MEMORY.md exists; parseable YAML frontmatter; all 9 H2 sections present

assertions.text: memory-setup-report-YYYY-MM-DD-HH-MM.md exists with the Report B (workspace mode) shape.
assertions.check: filesystem: a memory-setup-report-*.md file matches Report B template (no Validator Findings / Additive Merge Log / Conflict Log sections)

evals.name: inherited-boilerplate-third-mode-offered
evals.prompt: I just cloned the boilerplate and want to configure the workspace memory.
evals.fixture_notes: The canonical boilerplate-derived fixture. MEMORY.md + decisions.config.md + 8 per-store READMEs (including actions/ because shared_actions_root is declared).
evals.expected_output: Agent invokes build-agent-memory. Step 0a detects MEMORY.md AND non-empty memories/ and offers the third option. The user picks the third option. Step 1's validator runs and passes silently (no MISSING, no MISMATCHED). Steps 2-7 are no-ops (silent pass). Step 9 writes the connectivity-check entry. Step 10 writes Report C (workspace-confirm-and-update variant) with empty Additive Merge Log and empty Conflict Log.

assertions.text: Agent offers the workspace-confirm-and-update option at Step 0.
assertions.check: transcript: the mode menu includes a third option whose label or description mentions 'already present' or 'confirm-and-update' or 'inherited from a boilerplate'

assertions.text: No pre-existing fixture file is modified (MEMORY.md, decisions.config.md, the 8 per-store READMEs).
assertions.check: filesystem: state of MEMORY.md, decisions.config.md, and all per-store READMEs matches the fixture byte-for-byte
filesystem: memories/test/connectivity-check-*.md exists with today's date

assertions.text: Setup report is Report C variant with Validator Findings / Additive Merge Log (empty) / Conflict Log (empty) sections.
assertions.check: filesystem: memory-setup-report-*.md contains H2 sections 'Validator Findings', 'Additive Merge Log', 'Conflict Log'; the merge-log and conflict-log sections are empty or marked empty

evals.name: third-mode-gate-partial-state-hides-option
evals.prompt: Configure the memory for this workspace.
evals.fixture_notes: MEMORY.md is present at the workspace root, but memories/ is absent entirely. Step 0a's gate requires BOTH; this case must fall through to greenfield workspace mode.
evals.expected_output: Agent detects MEMORY.md but no memories/ folder. Step 0a's gate fails. Third option is NOT offered. Agent presents the two-option menu and additionally asks the user whether to keep MEMORY.md or remove it (per the Edge Cases row).

assertions.text: Agent does NOT offer the workspace-confirm-and-update option even though MEMORY.md exists.
assertions.check: transcript: the third option is absent from the mode menu

assertions.text: Agent surfaces the partial state and asks the user how to proceed.
assertions.check: transcript: the agent's response mentions the pre-existing MEMORY.md and asks the user to confirm whether to keep it or remove it

evals.name: workspace-confirm-and-update-additive-merge
evals.prompt: Finalise the inherited memory architecture for this repo.
evals.fixture_notes: Canonical fixture WITHOUT memories/restart-guides/README.md AND WITHOUT the `## Restart guides` H2 in MEMORY.md — two related missing artefacts the validator should detect and merge.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs the validator. V.3 flags memories/restart-guides/ as MISSING; V.1 flags `## Restart guides` as MISSING. Both go into the additive-merge log. Steps 6 and 7 write them from templates. No conflict is surfaced (additive-only).

assertions.text: MEMORY.md gains the `## Restart guides` section and nothing else changes in MEMORY.md.
assertions.check: filesystem: MEMORY.md now contains `## Restart guides`; all other H2 sections and their bodies are identical to the fixture

assertions.text: memories/restart-guides/ + README.md is created from the per-store template.
assertions.check: filesystem: memories/restart-guides/README.md exists and has MAGI frontmatter

assertions.text: No other pre-existing fixture file is modified.
assertions.check: filesystem: state of decisions.config.md and all other per-store READMEs matches the fixture byte-for-byte

assertions.text: Setup report records the two-entry additive-merge log.
assertions.check: filesystem: memory-setup-report-*.md Additive Merge Log section lists 'section ## Restart guides' and 'subdir restart-guides/' entries

evals.name: workspace-confirm-and-update-conflict-stop-and-ask
evals.prompt: Validate the inherited memory and make any updates needed.
evals.fixture_notes: Canonical fixture with MEMORY.md modified so root_prefix declares `store/` instead of the boilerplate-expected `memories/`. The validator must surface this as a conflict and stop.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs the validator. V.6 detects the root_prefix mismatch. Conflict-Surfacing Semantics kick in: agent stops, prints EXISTING vs SKILL-SHIPPED side-by-side, asks the user 'keep / replace / exit'. Default (no answer) is 'keep'.

assertions.text: Agent presents the root_prefix conflict with EXISTING and SKILL-SHIPPED labels.
assertions.check: transcript: model output contains both 'EXISTING' and 'SKILL-SHIPPED' (or equivalent labels) and the values 'store/' and 'memories/'

assertions.text: Agent offers exactly three resolutions: keep / replace / exit.
assertions.check: transcript: AskUserQuestion (or equivalent) presents three options whose labels match 'keep', 'replace', and 'exit' (or close paraphrases)

assertions.text: No file is written or modified before the user resolves the conflict.
assertions.check: filesystem: at the moment of the AskUserQuestion call, no new files have been created and no fixture file has been modified

evals.name: agent-mode-prereq-check
evals.prompt: Set up memory for my data-science agent.
evals.fixture_notes: An agent directory with IDENTITY.md present but SOUL.md and RULES.md absent. Agent mode requires all three identity files before proceeding.
evals.expected_output: Agent invokes the skill in agent mode. Step 1 attempts to read SOUL.md and RULES.md, finds them absent, and stops with the documented error message. No MEMORY.md is created.

assertions.text: Agent stops at Step 1 and tells the user to create SOUL.md (and RULES.md) first.
assertions.check: transcript: model output mentions SOUL.md and RULES.md as missing prerequisites; the phrase 'MEMORY.md must be created after' or equivalent appears

assertions.text: No MEMORY.md is created in the agent directory.
assertions.check: filesystem: the agent directory does not gain a MEMORY.md or memories/ tree
